Task: Explain why the sky appears blue, in three sentences.

steps.action:
The sky appears blue because of a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering, where sunlight interacts with the gases in Earth's atmosphere. Sunlight is made up of all colors of the visible spectrum, but shorter wavelengths of light (blue and violet) are scattered much more readily than longer wavelengths (red and orange) when they collide with gas molecules. Although violet light is scattered even more than blue, our eyes are more sensitive to blue light and some violet is absorbed in the upper atmosphere, so we perceive the sky as blue.
